title: McDonald’s Launches Desserts and Beverage with SpongeBob and One Piece
subtitle: New flavors and miniatures mix two franchises in exclusive promotion
excerpt: McDonald’s Brazil is launching a SpongeBob and One Piece collab featuring three new menu items and themed Happy Meal toys starting September 15.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On September 15, McDonald’s Brazil kicks off a new campaign combining SpongeBob and One Piece, bringing three new menu items and themed miniatures to the Happy Meal.

Cherry and Orange Top Sundae Arrives on the Menu

The first launch is the Cherry and Orange Top Sundae, which combines vanilla soft serve, cherry and orange syrup, paçoca crumbles, and two rolled wafer cookies. The dessert is served in a themed cup from the collection, featuring SpongeBob and Luffy.

Top Sundae-Flavored McColosso Follows the Same Line

The McColosso also receives the Top Sundae flavor, but is served in the traditional large waffle cone and does not include the paçoca crumbles. That way, fans can choose between two versions of the dessert in beverage format.

Mango and Pineapple Flavored Beverage Completes the Line

The beverage blends Sprite Zero, mango and pineapple syrup, and ice, and will not include free refills, being sold separately from the other campaign items.

Happy Meal Miniatures Mix Characters

The Happy Meal features around 12 miniatures that bring characters from the McDonald’s universe in the style of iconic One Piece characters. SpongeBob appears as Luffy, Gary as Chopper, Squidward as Sanji, Mr. Krabs as Jinbe, Mrs. Puff as Linlin, Sandy as Nami, Plankton as Usopp, Larry the Lobster as Franky, Patrick Star as Zoro, Pearl as Robin, the Flying Dutchman as Teach, and SpongeBob as Gears Luffy.

Availability and Campaign Period

According to an official McDonald’s document, the products are expected to officially arrive in stores starting September 15 and remain available throughout the campaign’s duration.

Campaign Reaches Several Countries

Brazil will be one of the countries to receive the new McDonald’s collection, which is also rolling out in various nations. In the promotional video, SpongeBob appears using Gear 5, while Sandy transforms into Nami, Mr. Krabs becomes Jinbe, Squidward becomes Sanji, and Pearl becomes Robin.

How to Keep Up with the Updates

The chain advises the public to stay up to date with the latest news through official McDonald’s Brazil social media channels.

With information from GKPB - Geek Publicitário, SpaceMoney.
